ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: The figure is a transition-state structure with curved electron-flow arrows; according to the question, first ignore these arrows and retain only the atomic connectivity. It can be seen that the main body is a fused bicyclic skeleton: the left side is a cyclohexane part, and the right side is fused with a cyclopentanone part, with a carbonyl group at the upper right corner. The upper bridgehead carbon is connected to an angular methyl group, and the stereochemical direction is indicated with a solid wedge bond; the lower bridgehead carbon is connected to a hydroxyl group, also indicated with a solid wedge bond. A tertiary carbon on the left cyclohexane is simultaneously connected to OH and a pyrrolidine nitrogen substituent. This nitrogen is part of a five-membered pyrrolidine ring, and a chiral carbon on the pyrrolidine ring is connected to a carboxylate substituent CO2− indicated with a dashed wedge. Reasoning: According to the specified method, write the SMILES starting from the angular methyl group of the fused bicyclic skeleton. The starting point is C[C@]12, indicating that the methyl is connected to a chiral bridgehead carbon with two ring-closure labels. Then proceed along the six-membered ring to the tertiary carbon bearing OH and the pyrrolidine nitrogen substituent, written as CCC(O)(N3CCC[C@H]3C(=O)[O-]), in which the substituent N3CCC[C@H]3 indicates that the nitrogen is in the pyrrolidine ring, and the chiral carbon is further connected to the C(=O)[O-] carboxylate. Next, continue through the lower bridgehead carbon and close to ring 1, written as C[C@@]1(O). Finally complete the fused cyclopentanone ring on the right side, written as CCC2=O. According to the solid-wedge and dashed-wedge stereochemical information in the figure, the corresponding stereochemical labels for the bridgehead and pyrrolidine chiral centers are [C@], [C@H], and [C@@]. Therefore the target isomeric SMILES is obtained.

method.method_draft: First describe the visible molecule as a graph after deleting the curved electron-flow arrows. Choose a SMILES traversal starting from the angular methyl on the fused bicyclic core. Trace the fused ring system with ring-closure labels to encode the cyclohexane fused to the cyclopentanone: start as C[C@]12..., continue around the six-membered ring to the tertiary carbon bearing O and the pyrrolidine N substituent, close through the lower bridgehead bearing OH, and finish the five-membered ketone ring as ...CCC2=O. Then encode the substituent on the tertiary carbon as (O)(N3CCC[C@H]3C(=O)[O-]), making the nitrogen part of a pyrrolidine ring and attaching the carboxylate to its stereogenic carbon. Finally assign @/@@ from the solid and dashed bonds in the image to obtain the isomeric SMILES: C[C@]12CCC(O)(N3CCC[C@H]3C(=O)[O-])C[C@@]1(O)CCC2=O.
method.CoT_raw:
图像描述：图中是一种带有弯曲电子流箭头的过渡态结构；按题意先忽略这些箭头，只保留原子连接关系。可见主体是一个稠合双环骨架：左侧为环己烷部分，右侧稠合一个环戊酮部分，右上角有羰基。上方桥头碳连有一个角甲基，并用实楔键表示立体方向；下方桥头碳连有一个羟基，也用实楔键表示。左侧环己烷上的一个叔碳同时连有 OH 和一个吡咯烷氮取代基。该氮是五元吡咯烷环的一部分，吡咯烷环上的一个手性碳连有虚楔表示的羧酸盐取代基 CO2−。

推理：按指定方法从稠合双环骨架的角甲基开始写 SMILES。起点为 C[C@]12，表示甲基连到带两个环闭合标号的手性桥头碳。随后沿六元环走到带 OH 和吡咯烷氮取代基的叔碳，写作 CCC(O)(N3CCC[C@H]3C(=O)[O-])，其中取代基 N3CCC[C@H]3 表示氮在吡咯烷环中，手性碳再连 C(=O)[O-] 羧酸盐。接着继续经过下方桥头碳并闭合到环 1，写作 C[C@@]1(O)。最后完成右侧稠合的环戊酮环，写作 CCC2=O。根据图中的实楔和虚楔立体信息，桥头和吡咯烷手性中心对应的立体标记为 [C@]、[C@H] 和 [C@@]。因此得到目标异构 SMILES。

planner_metadata.distinctiveness_rationale: This is the natural direct-transcription route: it treats the drawing as a molecular graph, removes only the electron-pushing arrows, and converts the observed connectivity and stereochemical wedges/dashes into an isomeric SMILES. Because the task asks for a single SMILES for one depicted structure, genuinely different solution routes are limited.
planner_metadata.image_role: Read the chemical drawing itself: ignore the two curved arrows; identify the fused cyclohexane/cyclopentanone core with a ketone on the five-membered ring, a vertical solid-wedge methyl at the upper ring junction, a vertical solid-wedge OH at the lower ring junction, a tertiary carbinol center on the left bearing HO and an attached pyrrolidine nitrogen, and the pyrrolidine ring bearing a dashed substituent to a carboxylate group, C(=O)[O-]. Read wedge/dash marks to assign the chiral centers.
planner_metadata.text_role: Use the question text only to determine the requested output form: provide the SMILES expression for the depicted transition-state structure and explicitly ignore the arrows rather than interpreting them as extra bonds or reaction steps.
planner_metadata.knowledge_role: Use standard skeletal-structure conventions: unlabeled vertices are carbons with implicit hydrogens, labeled O/N atoms are heteroatoms, curved arrows are electron-flow annotations rather than bonds, carboxylate is encoded as C(=O)[O-], ring closures in SMILES use matching digits, and wedge/dash stereochemistry must be converted into @/@@ annotations consistent with the chosen atom traversal.
